decision: Serial executor, StageSpec ordering, journaling, verified resume; retain existing algorithm path.
Reuse ordered_graph; extend with separate artifact nodes and typed producer links.
Reuse encode/decode and source_hash; legacy 24-hex cache identities remain historical.
File then receipt publication; do not silently reinterpret as new atomic directory cache.
Reuse staged-directory publication pattern; expand integrity and environment checks.
Retain cohort numerical behavior; opt-in workflows use explicit selected stages.
Existing forward/inverse and resolution operators; wrap bounded synthetic example.
Existing Nilearn fits and inference guards; cache OLS sufficient statistics without executable models.
Existing SHA-256 helpers and manifests; preserve historical schemas.
Reuse bounded nonpickle serialization and full checksum validation; schema versions unchanged.
Reuse explicit allowed-root resources; graph inspection reads graph metadata only.
One worker and cooperative cancellation; provenance navigation never submits work.
Published verified artifacts are truth; journals are observations, not cache validity evidence.
